name: autosprite
description: Turn one character image into a finished, engine-ready sprite sheet. Vision rigs the character into parts and joints, a deterministic skeletal animator draws fifteen animations and 8-direction movement from those parts, and the build measures its own output: a clip that comes apart has the responsible swing damped and reported, a transform is not allowed to break what the artist drew in one piece, and a walk keeps its feet on the floor. Exports to Unity, Godot, Phaser, GameMaker, RPG Maker and Unreal with every output frame provably built from the source's own palette.
